attributes.title: 33rd Annual AAEM Scientific Assembly (AAEM27)
attributes.summary:
AAEM27, the 33rd Scientific Assembly of the American Academy of Emergency Medicine, takes place Sunday, April 25, through Thursday, April 29, 2027, at the San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter on the River Walk. Add-on courses fill April 25 and the morning of April 26, and the main program starts with opening remarks around midday on April 26.

Registration is open. Early-bird rates run through January 11, 2027: $400 for physician members and $950 for physician non-members. Regular rates of $500 and $1,075 apply through April 18, then late rates of $600 and $1,200. Resident and student members pay $125, which AAEM treats as a deposit and refunds after they attend. The hotel booking deadline is April 2, 2027, and the full schedule is due in January. AAEM had not listed credit hours when we checked. Plan around the add-on days if you want one of the pre-conference courses, since they run before the general sessions.
